TO CHOOSE A NEW PASSWORD

1. Choose a new password. Open this link:
   https://app.afiax.africa/setpassword/9f1c2b7e-0d5a-4c1b-8a3e-2f6d7c8b9a01/3b9e1f0c7a2d4e6f
   Use at least 8 characters. Afiax won't accept a password that has
   appeared in a known data leak.

2. Sign in at https://app.afiax.africa/signin with your new password.
   You'll still type the 6-digit number from your authenticator app as usual.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Your old password stops working as soon as you set a new one. Setting a new password doesn't sign you out of devices where you're already signed in. To do that, open Security in Afiax (https://app.afiax.africa/security) and revoke any session you don't recognise.

If the link has already been used, or you've lost this email, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page again.

DIDN'T ASK FOR THIS?

Your password hasn't changed, and nothing will change unless someone uses the link in this email. You can ignore it. If you keep getting these emails without asking, tell Afiax support at support@afiax.africa.
